image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: mobile hairstylist teaching case, one CURRENT starting hairstyle only.
Primary request: a horizontal triptych showing the exact SAME fictional adult East Asian woman, about 40, front view, exact right-side profile, and back view. Keep facial and head proportions, hair length, clothing, lighting, and camera scale consistent across all three panels.
Current hairstyle: dark chestnut-brown, predominantly straight, slightly below collarbone length. A gently off-center part with long front sections and no short fringe. Fairly continuous medium-weight perimeter, a few soft natural bends at the ends, ordinary modest shine, no elaborate blowout, no round-brush root lift, no set waves or updo. Slightly fuller lower half, not dramatic bulk. All three panels must show this SAME current loose hairstyle, not alternatives.
Person: a natural softly angular face, relaxed neutral expression, normal unretouched skin texture. Muted dusty-blue cotton scoop-neck top with a modest neckline, same garment in all views. No jewellery, headpiece or accessories.
Composition: three equal panels separated by narrow neutral dividers. Pull camera back enough to include the ENTIRE head with margin, complete hair ends, the full neck, both complete shoulder outlines with visible space beyond their edges, and the upper chest to below sternum. Do NOT crop the shoulder edges. Same neutral eye-level lens, no head tilt or perspective exaggeration. Natural realistic head-neck-shoulder anatomy.
Setting: plain warm-grey background, consistent soft neutral natural light. Salon documentation feeling rather than fashion editorial. Clear individual strands, no beauty filter, no face slimming, no artificial glossy finish.
Constraints: no text, arrows, labels, watermark, salon tools, hands or logos. No reference-photo inset. NO daily/event comparison, no before/after, no proposed result. This is current condition to be analysed, NOT a validated transformation.
image.visualCheck: Original output and final WebP actually viewed: consistent fictional adult, garment, current collarbone-area loose hair and lighting across front/right-profile/back. Full head, hair perimeter, visible neck and shoulder context. Not measurement evidence, not proposed daily/event results.
